dedupe_keys.name: trnsys type 840 simulation model for pcm water storage tanks version 5 0

description: Andreas Heinz and colleagues at the Institute of Thermal Engineering, Graz University of Technology, developed TRNSYS Type 840 for thermal-storage simulation. Version 5.0 models water tanks containing phase-change-material modules shaped as cylinders, spheres or plates, and tanks filled with PCM slurry. Heat conduction uses a finite-difference representation in one or two dimensions, depending on geometry. An enthalpy method represents phase change and includes supercooling and hysteresis. The model is available for TRNSYS 17 and 18 and can support thermal-storage sizing and operation studies without a fixed geographic coverage or calendar period. Convection inside the liquid PCM is neglected. Version 5.0 corrects container heat-capacity handling and TRNSYS 18 issues. The repository assigns the MIT licence, but files are restricted: users must request a download link from the contact identified on the record. No charge is stated. The package format is not exposed in the public metadata. No exact version-specific related catalogue record was confirmed.
